item.title: Guided Nature Walk & Ranch House tour Anderson Marsh — Sat Sep 12, 8:30 AM — Anderson Marsh State Historic Park
item.description:
The next “Second Saturday” Guided Nature walk at Anderson Marsh State Historic Park will be held on Saturday, September 12, 2026.
The Guided Walk will begin at 8:30am. Bring binoculars and meet in the parking lot at 8:15am for an opportunity to observe the birds and other wildlife found in the picnic area. Sturdy shoes, a hat and water are suggested.
The September guided walk will be led by State Parks volunteer docent Roberta Lyons and will provide an opportunity to observe wildlife at the park and learn about their natural habitat, as well as to learn about the natural and cultural history of the area.
The walk will take between 1½ and 2 hours, depending on the route taken. Dogs are not allowed on the park trails.
A tour of the historic Anderson Ranch House will be available immediately after the conclusion of the walk.
There is no charge for the Nature Walk and Ranch House tour and parking is free for those attending.
Source: Press Democrat

This interactive experience highlights the connection between garden, vineyard, and kitchen, while teaching practical culinary techniques. The evening concludes with a shared meal paired with Quivira wines in a beautiful estate setting. item.description:
Start your Sunday with a peaceful introduction to meditation in the tranquil setting of our olive orchard. Led by registered yoga teacher, Joy Jacobsen, this session offers an opportunity to simply be with yourself, surrounded by nature, listening to the gentle vibrations of the world in a safe, peaceful, and restorative space.
We'll begin with a peaceful stroll to the orchard from our Farm Shop. Feel free to bring your own mat, though we'll also provide one if needed. Then we'll move into gentle standing stretches and mindful breathing—essential practices that prepare the body to become limber, relaxed, and comfortable for stillness. As you settle into a 20-minute meditation, Joy will hold space for your practice, opening and closing the session with the soothing sound of a singing bowl.
We'll conclude the experience back at the farm shop with fresh apple cider and sliced heirloom apples.

item.title: Culinary Student Lunch Pop-UP — Wed Sep 16, 11:30 AM — Sonoma Family Meal Community Kitchen
item.description:
Our Culinary Student Pop-Up Lunch Cafe is back! There will be two lunch service windows: **Wednesday through Friday on September 16th-18th and again 23rd-25th, 11:30 AM to 1 PM**. This tradition marks the culmination of our current adult culinary job training cohort in Petaluma, with every dish on the menu inspired and shaped by the students themselves. It's a chance for our trainees to put their new skills to the test working the line in a real service setting - and for you to taste what they've been working on and cheer them on as they graduate into their next chapter.
Consider treating your whole team or company to lunch those weeks - it's a great way to support our students while feeding your crew! There’s limited space to eat onsite, so please plan to pick up, take it with you, and enjoy.
Head to sonomafamilymeal.org for the full menu and option to place your order online in advance.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
